fees.description: Membership of $25 per month (inc. GST) to access these wholesale rates.
A $3 (inc. GST) fee applies if payment is dishonoured or reversed.
A fee of 1% applies to payments made by credit or debit card.

Reconnection Fee: Fee may be charged when reconnecting or reading your meter when you move into a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Actual charges passed through from your distributor may vary, see www.amber.com.au/fees for more information.

Disconnection Fee: Fee may be charged when disconnecting or reading your meter when you move out of a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Actual charges passed through from your distributor may vary, see www.amber.com.au/fees for more information

electricityContract.terms: For full terms and conditions, visit https://www.amber.com.au/terms. If you don't have a smart meter we will install one for you. Available to residential customers in Evoenergy's distribution region with a flat rate tariff. For illustrative purposes, tariff 010 assumed. Feed-In Tariffs are only valid if applicable

discounts.description: Welcome credit of $150 applied over 12 months. New residential customers only who are also customers of CommBank (CBA) in the Yello Plus segment and link their CBA credit card or bank account as Amber payment method. Customers are ineligible to receive any remaining credit months if they cancel their Amber account, switch their payment method to a non-CBA account, or their CBA card expires. Additional eligibility requirements apply, see Amber website.

electricityContract.variation: Prices are not fixed. Usage is charged at the same wholesale electricity costs that are charged to us. Prices are determined by a range of factors, including government rebates, network fees and wholesale market costs. The rate listed in 'General Usage' is for illustrative purpose only under Amber's Price Guarantee and assumes a customer is on a flat rate tariff. It does not apply if you are on a different network tariff.

greenPowerCharges.description: 100% GreenPower for 0.8008 cents/kWh (inc. GST) option avaliable. See website for more information.

solarFeedInTariff.description: Wholesale price with guaranteed min of 0c/kWh over a 12 month period.

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: Amber Offers no lock in contracts or exit fees. Prices may vary in accordance with the terms and conditions.
